description_en: Replaces an expired additional certificate for an HTTPS listener
description_zh: 当原证书过期需替换为新的证书且关联域名不变时，您可以调用UpdateAdditionalCertificateWithListener接口为HTTPS监听替换扩展证书
kebab_example: aliyun ga update-additional-certificate-with-listener --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --domain example.com --certificate-id 609200-cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAdditionalCertificateWithListener

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false: performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会替换扩展证书。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the listener. Only HTTPS listeners are supported
parameters.help_zh: 监听ID。仅支持HTTPS协议类型的监听
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name associated with the additional certificate that you want to replace
parameters.help_zh: 原扩展证书绑定的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replacement certificate
parameters.name: certificate_id
